transformations.rationale: HTTP operations accept inputs across URI path templates, query parameters, headers, and request bodies. The canonical representation wraps these disjoint surfaces into a single Draft-07 object with four discrete transport containers (path, query, header, body).

Tool-calling parameter interfaces require closed object schemas (additionalProperties: false) across root and transport surface containers to prevent LLM argument hallucination and enforce strict argument validation. Raw OpenAPI specification omitted additionalProperties (defaulting to open validation). This normalization tightens schema permissiveness and is explicitly classified as a non-lossless wrapper policy.
Selected raw operation summary per deterministic precedence hierarchy (Step 1: summary, Step 2: description, Step 3: template fallback).
